column1: # config/localisation_map.tsv -- source localisation labels -> common vocabulary (DESIGN.md v2.3 §5.1b; committed at M4).
# Vocabulary (13): nucleus, nucleolus, nuclear envelope, cytosol, mitochondrion, ER, Golgi, plasma membrane, vesicles/endosome/lysosome, peroxisome, lipid droplet, centrosome/cilium, cytoskeleton.
# compartment: '|'-separated when a label spans two compartments; empty = label not mapped (ignored; e.g. sperm-specific, mitotic or aggregate structures).
# GO_CC rows: a GO CC term maps to the compartment of the FIRST row (lowest priority number) among its is_a/part_of ancestors (reflexive); terms with none are ignored.
# Agreement/compatibility rule (src/orthogonal.py::compartments_match): two sets match if they share a compartment after adding parents nucleolus->nucleus and nuclear envelope->nucleus.
# Multi-localised (§5.1b): >= 2 distinct compartments in any admitted source after collapsing nucleolus and nuclear envelope into nucleus.
